stem:
Priya rubs two balloons on her woollen shawl during winter in Jaipur. She then brings the two rubbed balloons close to each other.
What will the balloons do, and why?

options.text: They attract each other, because rubbing makes the balloons sticky.
They repel each other, because both balloons carry the same kind of charge.
They attract each other, because both balloons carry the same kind of charge.
Nothing happens, because the balloons are uncharged after rubbing.

teacher.key_rationale: Rubbing both balloons on the same woollen shawl transfers the same kind of charge to each balloon; like charges repel, so the balloons move apart. Option A is the trap based on the misconception that charged objects are 'sticky' and always attract.
